hypotheses.statement: The persisted producer snapshot of run 43542234373 failed at workflow step 'Run lane cycle' with 'Process completed with exit code 1.' and NO retryable LEX_* annotation (the recorded ORCHESTRATION_AGENT_LAUNCH_FAILURE_EXIT_1_NO_RETRYABLE_SIGNATURE class, same class as 43404561250), after approximately 77 seconds; steps 'Validate active MVP producer state' and 'Enforce lane write scope' were skipped; audit and integrate jobs were skipped; no audit ref cycle/core/evaluation/43542234373/audit exists; and both its team and team-attempt-1 refs hash to 8c07cacab54e12a008cf50f207898154d43f5926, identical to cycle/core/evaluation/43531218191/team, i.e. an EMPTY durable delta against the prior successful producer.

The chain root cause is audit-side quantum starvation plus resume failures, not a producer, product or validation failure: 43531218191's team job succeeded end-to-end (Run lane cycle, state validation and write scope all success) and committed the deliverable at 8c07caca, but its independent audit job failed after ~45m49s at 'Independent audit' with annotations LEX_WORK_QUANTUM_EXPIRED seconds=2700 / 'Process completed with exit code 78.' so no gate was written, no audit ref exists and integrate was skipped; resume 43541879339 then hit the zero-delta guard (LEX_ZERO_DELTA_REPAIR / exit 67, correctly empty delta because the deliverable was already committed); resume 43542234373 then died at Run lane cycle with exit 1 and no retryable signature. Therefore the snapshot's completed, validation-passing deliverable has NEVER received an independent audit verdict, and every resume that adds no delta re-fails the same way. This instrument breaks the loop by producing a real, in-scope delta.
